title: Like Videos, Earn USDT
intro: A text offers money for liking videos. It sounds almost too easy.
The first payout even arrives within minutes.

screen.context: You never signed up for any job site.

msg.text: Your first payout arrives in 5 minutes!

pay.label: Pay for liking videos
pay.lens: Nobody pays this much to like videos.
pay.why: The pay is bait. No business earns from paid likes.

link.label: A look-alike work link
link.lens: taskboost-work.live is a sign-up page, not a company.
link.why: Real employers have their own sites and contracts.

chat.label: Move to a private chat
chat.lens: The manager is on a private chat.
chat.why: Scammers move you away from places where they can be reported.

first.label: A quick first payout
first.lens: A small first payout builds trust.
first.why: The small payout is the hook for a big deposit later.

big.label: Up to 300 USDT a day
big.why: A huge number is meant to make you greedy.

noexp.label: No experience needed
noexp.why: It sounds kind but is part of the bait.

actions.label: Look the company up on my own
Delete it and report the text as junk

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block more of these texts.

verify.line: No company by that name existed, and the FTC-style advice said easy pay for likes is a scam. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. A report would help others.

go_ahead.line: The tasks paid 5 USDT, then asked for a 200 USDT "top-up" to unlock the next level. It never ended.

what_if.go_ahead: The small first payout is the hook. The deposit comes next.
what_if.verify: Looking the company up was smart. Reporting helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

trap.title: TaskBoost · Join
trap.ask: Register and get 5 free USDT today.

golden_rule: If a job pays you to like things, it will soon ask you to pay. Walk away at the first sign.

quick_check.q: A text offers 300 USDT a day for liking videos and moves you to a private chat. What do you do?

options.text: Do not join. Delete the text and report it

quick_check.explain: Easy pay and a private chat are the two signs of a task scam.

hints.nudge: Why would anyone pay you to like videos?

rows.v: Pay a little first, then ask you to deposit
